text.text: When an alert fires, find the matching runbook, follow its steps, and write down anything that was wrong. The schedule below says who to call.
On-call schedule
Runbooks
Open any runbook to find the full outline (when to use it, checks, steps, rollback) already inside it.
Services
Primary answers the page within five minutes. If they do not, the secondary is paged automatically.
Handoff checklist
Open incidents and who is handling them
Alerts that fired and what was done
Anything that looks like it will break soon
Planned maintenance in the next shift
Keeping runbooks alive
A runbook nobody has tested is a guess. Every runbook should be run through once a quarter, ideally by someone who did not write it.
Pick Tested this month and Stale from the lists above.
Run the steps against a safe environment. Fix anything that no longer matches.
Set the tested date and press Mark current.
Stale runbooks
Coverage by service
Your first shift
Install the paging app and test a page.
Read the three newest postmortems.
Shadow the current primary for one evening.
During a shift
Acknowledge every page within five minutes.
Open the runbook before touching anything.
Write what you did in the incident channel as you go.
If you need to swap
Find a teammate, change the schedule yourself, and tell the head of infrastructure.
If you are exhausted
Hand over. A tired engineer makes the second incident.
